comment: Licence texts CrowSetup compiles in that are NOT inside the crate sources cargo downloads. Copied byte for byte from the source named here; tools/installer_notices.py holds each file against its sha256.

webview2-rs.LICENSE.why: the three crates declare MIT but publish no licence file; the text is the repository's LICENSE at the commits their .cargo_vcs_info.json names (edc2caf8 for webview2-com 0.39.1 and webview2-com-sys 0.39.1, dffa41a8 for webview2-com-macros 0.8.1 -- the same git blob at both)

dlopen2.LICENSE.why: Linux build only (through tao); both crates declare MIT but publish no licence file; the text is the repository's LICENSE at cc80e4a0, the commit .cargo_vcs_info.json names for dlopen2 0.8.2 and dlopen2_derive 0.4.3

Microsoft.Web.WebView2.LICENSE.txt.why: webview2-com-sys links Microsoft's WebView2 loader statically on MSVC targets, so CrowSetup.exe carries Microsoft code; LICENSE.txt from the NuGet package the library comes from

Microsoft.Web.WebView2.NOTICE.txt.why: NOTICE.txt from the same NuGet package

webview2_loader.why: the crate's x64/WebView2LoaderStatic.lib is byte-identical to build/native/x64/WebView2LoaderStatic.lib in that package (compared 2026-10-03); the SDK version is the one crates/update-bindings pins at upstream commit 12be1a54, released with webview2-com-sys 0.39.0
